title: Croatian Beef Pasta
description: A hearty beef-based pasta dish originating from Croatia, perfect for a Sunday evening. This recipe combines tender beef with flavorful herbs and a rich stock.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: Use a lean cut of beef for the best results

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.amount: 8 ounces, such as pappardelle or fettuccine
ingredients.notes: Choose a pasta shape that will hold onto the beef and sauce well

ingredients.name: stock
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality stock for the best flavor

ingredients.name: snappy
ingredients.notes: Use fresh thyme if available for a more vibrant flavor

ingredients.name: herbal
ingredients.notes: Rosemary pairs well with beef and adds a savory flavor to the dish

instructions: Bring the stock to a boil in a large pot over high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the pasta to the pot and cook according to package instructions until al dente.
Stir in the thyme and rosemary, and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the beef and pasta hot, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
